nonduplication_rules.rule: Exact one-to-one aliases, packaged copies or execution wrappers of an existing stable scenario contribute zero additive scenario count.
A new title or stable ID alone does not establish new coverage.

A proposed case is additive only when at least one material test dimension changes: actor/authority, object identity or ownership state, timing/concurrency, failure/recovery path, device/interaction/accessibility mode, bounded scale/density, or cross-domain authority handoff.
If the changed dimension cannot alter the observable safe oracle, the proposal is presumptively duplicate and should be linked to the existing case instead.

Cross-domain composition can justify a new case when the composition creates a risk not proven by the component cases separately, such as reveal plus revocation, transfer plus stale version, or approval plus reconnect.
Scale cases must name the deterministic fixture size used in that case but may not turn a QA fixture size into a product capacity, performance or support promise.
Accessibility/mobile cases must prove task and semantic parity, not merely render the same content at another viewport.
No scenario may invent F024 Pack Lifecycle semantics or an owning-domain rule that its source leaves unspecified.

baseline_coverage_anchors.basic_campaign_local_edit: IA09-FX-014 and PPIA-08 already prove Campaign-local scope preservation.
